The primary subject is a sliced cucumber in the foreground, showing its cross-section with pale flesh and seeds. Surrounding it are red cherry tomatoes, red chili peppers, and a portion of another fruit (possibly a pear or apple) in the upper right. The lighting is bright, creating specular highlights on the wet surfaces of the vegetables.
